name: [BETA] Anime Rumble 💥
desc:
💥 Welcome to Anime Rumble! 💥

⭐ Use code "beta" for FREE rewards!
✨ Get 10,000 Likes for a NEW CODE! ✨

🔥 Step into the world of Anime Rumble, where you can summon your favorite heroes and build the ultimate team!
⚔️ Defeat powerful enemies and take on epic boss battles!
🍀 Feeling lucky? Summon rare warriors and trade them with your friends! 💜

🌀 Summon Secret units and make your team strongest!
💀 Join in Raid and defeat all levels!
😈 Play Dungeons with your friends and earn rare items!
👊 Fight with Boss and add him to your team!

Roblox Premium members get extra luck! 💎
Invite friends for a luck boost! 👥

📝 Send us your feedback to help improve the game!
